answer: Histories are stored in yarrow, checked in quill, and dawn reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 4960 identities would post 1770 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
